answer: What survives to the crystal is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, idle agents bleed standing. The terrace lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the harbor is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
